```{r Prepare to merge}
Mar_SpKey <- Mar_SpKey %>%
  mutate(common_name = tolower(common_name))

Mar_SpKey_filtered <- Mar_SpKey %>% select(common_name, fishery, highest_taxonomic_id, highest_taxonomic_resolution, species, genus, family, order, class, functional_major_groups_sm= IHH_functional_major_groups_sm)

Mar_SpKey_filtered <- Mar_SpKey_filtered %>%
  select(common_name, fishery, highest_taxonomic_id, highest_taxonomic_resolution,
         species, genus, family, order, class, functional_major_groups_sm) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("IHH_", .x))

Hem_SpKey <- Hem_SpKey %>%
  mutate(common_name = tolower(common_name))

Hem_SpKey_filtered <- Hem_SpKey %>%
  select(Hem_common_name= common_name, species)

Hem_SpKey_filtered<- Hem_SpKey_filtered %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(Hem_common_name) %>%
  mutate(species_num = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

Hem_SpKey_filtered <- Hem_SpKey_filtered %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = species_num,
    values_from = species,
    names_prefix = "Hem_species_"
  )
```

## Filtering out key words from landing receipts:
```{r Load in landings and species data (if needed)}
Landings_GoC<- readRDS(here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/fis/v2025/int/juan_carlos/GoC_Landings_2000.present_EMF_created.rds"))
# n = 3716415 obs.

merged_SpKey_main<- read.csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/general/Species_Keys/Reconciled_Master_SpKey_Nov302025.csv")
# 802 obs. of 61 vars.
```

```{r Filter out keywords from recorded_taxa_name to get recorded_taxa_name_clean}
#### Keyword List ####

keyword_list <- c(
  "S.C.", "S/C", "S",
  "ENTERO", "ENTERA", "IND", "ENT",
  "FRESCO", "FRESCA", "FCA", "FCO", "FC",
  "ECO",
  "CONG", "CONGELADO",
  "VIVO", "VIVA", "VIVAS", "VIVITA",
  "DE CULTIVO", "DE CULTIVO VIVO", "ABASTO RANCHO", "RANCHO",
  "HUEVA DE",
  "FILETE", "FILETE DE", "ECA", "FILETE DE ECO", "DESHUESADA", "CARNE", "CARNE DE",
  "DESCABEZADO", "DES", "DSC", "DESC",  "DESV", "DESVICERADO",
  "CABEZA DE", "BUCHE", "BUCHE DE", "TRIPA DE", "COLAS DE", "MANOS DE", "MANOS", "ANCAS DE", "ANCAS", "ANCA",
  "PIEL DE ECA", "PIEL DE SECA", "PIEL DE", "PIEL",
  "SECO DE", "SECA", "SECA DE", "SECO", "SECO DE",
  "COCINERO", "COCIDO", "COCIDA", "COCIDAS", "ASADO",
  "ALETA", "ALETA ECA DE", "ALETA FCA DE",
  "DE ALTA MAR",
  "CONCHA DE", "CONCHA",
  "POLVO DE",
  "CARNADA", "P/CARNADA",
  "DE AGUA DULCE",
  "MANTO", "MANTO DE", "PULPA DE", "PULPA FRESCA", "PULPO DE", "TENTACULOS DE", "TUBO DE", "TUBO",
  "NO APTO PARA EMPAQUE"
)

# Sort by descending length to match multi-word keywords first
keyword_list <- keyword_list[order(nchar(keyword_list), decreasing = TRUE)]


#### Escape regex metacharacters ####

escape_regex <- function(x) {
  str_replace_all(x, "([.|(){}+*?^$\\[\\]\\\\])", "\\\\\\1")
}

keyword_list_escaped <- escape_regex(keyword_list)

#### Create safe lookaround-based regex: ####
#   This allows punctuation inside keywords (e.g., "S.C.")

keyword_pattern <- paste0(
  "(?<![A-Za-z0-9])(",
  paste(keyword_list_escaped, collapse = "|"),
  ")(?![A-Za-z0-9])"
)


#### Apply the extraction & cleaning ####

Landings_Goc_Cleaned <- Landings_GoC %>%
  
  # 1. rename at the start
  rename(recorded_taxa_name = species_name) %>%
  
  # 2. extract all keyword matches
  mutate(
    keywords = str_extract_all(recorded_taxa_name, keyword_pattern)
  ) %>%
  
  # 3. force exactly 5 keywords per row (vectorized)
  mutate(
    keywords = lapply(keywords, function(x) { length(x) <- 5; x })
  ) %>%
  
  # 4. unnest into 5 new columns
  unnest_wider(keywords, names_sep = "_") %>%
  
  # 5. vectorized cleaning
  mutate(
    recorded_taxa_name_clean = recorded_taxa_name,
    
    # clean non-exception rows by removing keyword pattern
    recorded_taxa_name_clean = if_else(
      recorded_taxa_name %in% c(
        "TIBURON ALETA BLANCA",
        "BERRUGATA ALETA AMARILLA",
        "CORVINA ALETA CORTA",
        "CORVINA ALETA AMARILLA"
      ),
      recorded_taxa_name_clean,
      str_remove_all(recorded_taxa_name_clean, keyword_pattern)
    ),

    # remove Y, DE, P/
    recorded_taxa_name_clean = str_remove_all(recorded_taxa_name_clean, "\\bY\\b"),
    recorded_taxa_name_clean = str_remove_all(recorded_taxa_name_clean, "\\bDE\\b"),
    recorded_taxa_name_clean = str_remove_all(recorded_taxa_name_clean, "\\bP/\\b"),

    # remove punctuation
    recorded_taxa_name_clean = str_replace_all(recorded_taxa_name_clean, "[.,/\\\\]+", " "),

    # collapse whitespace
    recorded_taxa_name_clean = str_squish(recorded_taxa_name_clean)
  )







Landings_Goc_Cleaned %>% distinct(recorded_taxa_group, recorded_taxa_name_clean)

# EXTRACT: scientific names from parentheses
Landings_Goc_Cleaned$recorded_scientific_name <- sub(".*\\(([^)]+)\\).*", "\\1", Landings_Goc_Cleaned$recorded_taxa_name_clean)
# Set NA if original string had no parentheses:
Landings_Goc_Cleaned$recorded_scientific_name[!grepl("\\(", Landings_Goc_Cleaned$recorded_taxa_name_clean)] <- NA
# Trim whitespace:
Landings_Goc_Cleaned$recorded_scientific_name <- trimws(Landings_Goc_Cleaned$recorded_scientific_name)

# CLARIFY: Make a column that tells the reader whether or not the scientific_name was recorded in the original record:
Landings_Goc_Cleaned$scientific_name_recorded_T.F <- ifelse(
  !is.na(Landings_Goc_Cleaned$recorded_scientific_name) & Landings_Goc_Cleaned$recorded_scientific_name != "",
  T, F)

# Convert scientific_name to proper binomial capitalization:
capitalize_binomial <- function(x){
  x <- tolower(x)                    # all lowercase
  words <- strsplit(x, " ")[[1]]     # split words
  if(length(words) >= 2){
    words[1] <- paste0(toupper(substring(words[1],1,1)), substring(words[1],2))  # Genus capitalized
    words[2] <- words[2]  # species lowercase
    return(paste(words[1], words[2]))
  } else {
    return(x)
  }
}

Landings_Goc_Cleaned$recorded_scientific_name <- sapply(Landings_Goc_Cleaned$recorded_scientific_name, function(x){
  if(!is.na(x)) capitalize_binomial(x) else NA
})


# Make a column for recorded_common_name
Landings_Goc_Cleaned <- Landings_Goc_Cleaned %>%
  mutate(
    recorded_common_name = str_trim(
      str_remove(recorded_taxa_name_clean, "\\s*\\([^)]*\\)")
    )
  )

# Make recorded_common_name lowercase:
Landings_Goc_Cleaned <- Landings_Goc_Cleaned %>%
  mutate(recorded_common_name = tolower(recorded_common_name))

length(unique(Landings_Goc_Cleaned$recorded_common_name))
length(unique(Landings_Goc_Cleaned$recorded_taxa_group))
# 797 unique names and 734 common names (versus 973 with the less comprehensive keywords_list), over 57 taxanomic groups
```

```{r Testing FASTER CLEANER option}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)

#-------------------------------#
# 1. KEYWORD LIST + REGEX
#-------------------------------#

keyword_list <- c(
  "S.C.", "S/C", "S",
  "ENTERO", "ENTERA", "IND", "ENT",
  "FRESCO", "FRESCA", "FCA", "FCO", "FC",
  "ECO",
  "CONG", "CONGELADO",
  "VIVO", "VIVA", "VIVAS", "VIVITA",
  "DE CULTIVO", "DE CULTIVO VIVO", "ABASTO RANCHO", "RANCHO",
  "HUEVA DE",
  "FILETE", "FILETE DE", "ECA", "FILETE DE ECO", "DESHUESADA", "CARNE", "CARNE DE",
  "DESCABEZADO", "DES", "DSC", "DESC", "DESV", "DESVICERADO",
  "CABEZA DE", "BUCHE", "BUCHE DE", "TRIPA DE", "COLAS DE", "MANOS DE", "MANOS", "ANCAS DE", "ANCAS", "ANCA",
  "PIEL DE ECA", "PIEL DE SECA", "PIEL DE", "PIEL",
  "SECO DE", "SECA", "SECA DE", "SECO", "SECO DE",
  "COCINERO", "COCIDO", "COCIDA", "COCIDAS", "ASADO",
  "ALETA", "ALETA ECA DE", "ALETA FCA DE",
  "DE ALTA MAR",
  "CONCHA DE", "CONCHA",
  "POLVO DE",
  "CARNADA", "P/CARNADA",
  "DE AGUA DULCE",
  "MANTO", "MANTO DE", "PULPA DE", "PULPA FRESCA", "PULPO DE", "TENTACULOS DE", "TUBO DE", "TUBO",
  "NO APTO PARA EMPAQUE"
)

# sort long-to-short so the longest keyword matches first
keyword_list <- keyword_list[order(nchar(keyword_list), decreasing = TRUE)]

# Escape regex meta-characters using stringi (faster)
keyword_list_escaped <- stringi::stri_replace_all_regex(keyword_list, "([.|(){}+*?^$\\[\\]\\\\])", "\\\\$1")

# Final compound regex
keyword_pattern <- paste0(
  "(?<![A-Za-z0-9])(",
  paste(keyword_list_escaped, collapse = "|"),
  ")(?![A-Za-z0-9])"
)


#-------------------------------#
# 2. IDENTIFY SPECIAL CASES
#-------------------------------#

special_cases <- c(
  "TIBURON ALETA BLANCA",
  "BERRUGATA ALETA AMARILLA",
  "CORVINA ALETA CORTA",
  "CORVINA ALETA AMARILLA"
)

#-------------------------------#
# 3. CLEANING PIPELINE
#-------------------------------#

Landings_GoC_Cleaned <- Landings_GoC %>%
  rename(recorded_taxa_name = species_name) %>%
  
  # Extract keywords for all rows
  mutate(
    keywords_list = str_extract_all(recorded_taxa_name, keyword_pattern)
  ) %>%
  
  # Pad each list to exactly 5 keywords
  mutate(
    keywords_list = map(keywords_list, ~ { length(.x) <- 5; .x })
  ) %>%
  
  # Spread into separate columns
  unnest_wider(keywords_list, names_sep = "_") %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("keywords_", 1:5), starts_with("keywords_list")) %>%
  
  # Clean recorded_taxa_name_clean
  mutate(
    recorded_taxa_name_clean = if_else(
      recorded_taxa_name %in% special_cases,
      recorded_taxa_name,
      str_remove_all(recorded_taxa_name, keyword_pattern)
    ),
    
    # Remove Y / DE / P/
    recorded_taxa_name_clean = str_remove_all(recorded_taxa_name_clean, "\\b(Y|DE|P/)\\b"),
    
    # Remove punctuation
    recorded_taxa_name_clean = str_replace_all(recorded_taxa_name_clean, "[.,/\\\\]+", " "),
    
    # Collapse whitespace
    recorded_taxa_name_clean = str_squish(recorded_taxa_name_clean),
    
    # Extract scientific name
    recorded_scientific_name = str_extract(recorded_taxa_name_clean, "\\(([^)]+)\\)") %>%
      str_replace_all("\\(|\\)", ""),
    
    scientific_name_recorded_T.F = !is.na(recorded_scientific_name),
    
    # Capitalize scientific name
    recorded_scientific_name = if_else(
      scientific_name_recorded_T.F,
      str_to_title(recorded_scientific_name),
      NA_character_
    ),
    
    # Extract common name
    recorded_common_name = str_trim(str_remove(recorded_taxa_name_clean, "\\s*\\([^)]*\\)")),
    recorded_common_name = str_to_lower(recorded_common_name)
  )


#-------------------------------#
# 4. REORDER COLUMN NAMES
#-------------------------------#

Landings_GoC_Cleaned <- Landings_GoC_Cleaned %>%
  select(
    # General info
    state, office_name, landing_site, landing_site_key, landing_site_primary, GoC, lat, long,
    year, month,
    receipt_date_fixed, period_start_fixed, period_end_fixed,
    fleet, acuaculture_production, eu_rnpa, eu_name, vessel_rnpa, vessel_name,
    
    # Species info
    main_species_group, recorded_taxa_name,
    
    # Cleaned / derived names
    recorded_taxa_name_clean, recorded_scientific_name,
    scientific_name_recorded_T.F, recorded_common_name,
    
    # Keywords
    keywords_1, keywords_2, keywords_3, keywords_4, keywords_5,
    
    # Landing details
    landed_weight, live_weight, value
 
  )


# OUT OF CURIOUSITY:
length(unique(Landings_GoC_Cleaned$recorded_common_name))
length(unique(Landings_GoC_Cleaned$main_species_group))
# 734 common names (versus 973 with the less comprehensive keywords_list), over 57 taxanomic groups
```
